decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Location Plan 21082-P001-A dated 23.03.2026;Existing Site Plan 21082-S001-A RevA dated 08.06.2026;Proposed Plans & Elevation 21082-P001-A dated 23.03.2026; SuDS Pro Forma.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The windows on the side and rear walls shall be obscure glazed and shall be non-opening below 1.7 metres above finished floor level. The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained in that form.Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwellinghouse known as 138 Edenbridge Road, Enfield, EN1 2HU, and shall not be used, occupied, sold, let or otherwise disposed of as a separate dwelling or independent residential unit.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains ancillary to the host dwelling and does not form a separate residential unit, in the interests of protecting the character of the area, neighbouring amenity and the proper planning of the site.
description: Detached outbuilding at rear for use as Granny Annex.
